title: eval-harness: per-prompt CI metrics integration and quality gating
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: We want per-prompt quality gating in CI so that regressions in specific high-value prompt sets fail fast and tie to metric deltas. This PR integrates per-prompt metrics into the eval-harness CI flow, adds a configurable quality gate rule set, and wires the gating results into CI checks so PRs can fail with actionable summaries. Changes include: - new per_prompt_metrics exporter that calculates AUC/accuracy/coverage per prompt set and emits a small JSON summary; - CI hook that downloads baseline metrics, compares current run using configurable thresholds, and fails with a concise diff if any prompt group regresses beyond thresholds; - a lightweight rule DSL in eval_configs/quality_gates.yml allowing Product/PMs to set per-prompt critical/major/minor thresholds; - dashboard telemetry events (metrics.gate.result) and clearer failure logs for devs; - unit and integration tests for gating logic. Checklist: - [x] implement metric exporter and comparator - [x] add quality gate config and validation - [x] add CI workflow and GitHub check integration - [x] add unit/integration tests - [x] update docs and examples - [x] run end-to-end on canary project (perf-canary) Related: ENG-7212 (linear), PM-438. This description is intentionally continuous (no section breaks) and includes context, design rationale, and rollout notes. Rollout plan: land behind feature flag, enable on a small set of high-value repos (perf-canary, redwood-docs) for 1 week, then enable org-wide. If early false positives appear, thresholds are adjustable via quality_gates.yml and we will temporarily treat failures as warnings until tuned.

review_comments: Michael Chen: Overall looks good. Two requests: 1) tighten the schema validation on quality_gates.yml so a malformed threshold can't block CI, 2) can we add a fallback to treat failures as warnings when the feature flag is off?
Ava Martinez: Addressed both in latest commit. Added schema validation using jsonschema and a --treat-as-warning flag controlled by CI context. See commit d9bc001 for CI check summary changes.
Ruth O'Connor: Can you add a short explanation in the README about how to interpret gate diffs? I had to look through the code to understand severity levels.
Ava Martinez: Added docs/examples and an example failure summary. Also added a helper script scripts/format_gate_diff.py to produce human-friendly output for reviewers.
Devon Lee: CI run failed initially on macOS runner (timeout on e2e). Looks like some integration tests assume a Linux-only binary. Please gate those tests.
Ava Martinez: Split the CI job so platform-specific e2e tests run only on linux-runner. Tests updated in run_per_prompt_eval.yml.
Michael Chen: Approved after schema validation and gating-as-warning behavior added. Leaving final approval to Ruth for docs.
